narration.text: [whispers] The most famous ghost photograph ever taken. Watch it develop. [long pause] [softly] Raynham Hall, Norfolk. September, nineteen thirty-six. Two photographers from Country Life magazine. [long pause] They had taken one picture of the great staircase. They were setting up a second. [long pause] Then the assistant saw something on the stairs. A shape, like vapour, coming down towards them. Slowly becoming a woman. [long pause] He shouted, take it. The flash went off. The other man saw nothing. [long pause] Country Life printed it that December. Experts said the negative had not been touched. [long pause] Skeptics say double exposure. Or something on the lens. [long pause] People had reported a lady in brown on these stairs for a hundred years. [long pause] [whispers] The print is still developing.
